newsitem.title: UK: Romania examining FX crawling peg variant - BNR head.
newsitem.headline: Romania examining FX crawling peg variant - BNR head.

text.p: Mugur Isarescu, governor of the National Bank of Romania (BNR), said the central bank would keep the current free-floating exchange rate system for now but it was considering a shift towards a variant of the crawling-peg system.
"I don't think classic crawling-peg system is what Romania needs as we have a very liberal, full-retention, foreign exchange regime," he said late on Thursday after a presentation to investors.

"I'm more biased to a target zone with the exchange rate determined by the market and the central bank announcing a zone of intervention," Isarescu said. although he added he felt it was premature to speak about the specifics of any new system.

But the "target zone", he said, might be set with inflation and the current account in mind. "This will solve the key issue for importers, exporters and foreign investors which is the predictability of the exchange rate." -- London Newsroom 171 542 6414
